# Base64 encoder / decoder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/base64/

Encode UTF-8 text as Base64 and decode Base64 back into readable text. Unicode text, including Nepali, is supported.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Encode a short message containing non-ASCII characters, then decode it to verify the original text.

## Limits and checks

Base64 is not encryption. This tool handles text; it does not turn binary files into a downloadable file format.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
